MR Safety
The Ember Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 10 T/m.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- WB-SAR ≤ 4 W/kg.
- No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session.
- Wait 15 minutes before the next imaging session.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Stimulation OFF.
Scan regions: Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below).
The image artifact extends approximately 40 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
